name: ThunderCat Subtitles
description: Search SubtitleCat and Thunder, rank matches by title and media identifiers, and download subtitles through Jellyfin.
overview: SubtitleCat and Thunder subtitle search for Jellyfin

versions.changelog:
- Prefer a clean Simplified Chinese subtitle across every ranked SubtitleCat result before falling back to Traditional Chinese.
- Reject subtitle downloads containing replacement characters or obvious Chinese mojibake, then continue with the next candidate.
- Add structured diagnostics for search keywords, requested language, ranked candidates, download attempts, rejection reasons, and final selection.
- Suppress repeated automated downloads of the same language after the first successful save.
- Retry alternate SubtitleCat language variants when a preferred download link is unavailable.
- Repair SRT files that omit the first cue index so Jellyfin can recognize them.
- Propagate provider download failures instead of returning an invalid empty subtitle response.
- Migrate the plugin from Emby to Jellyfin 10.10.7.
- Preserve SubtitleCat, Thunder, CID matching, security checks, and configuration diagnostics.
